  <EvidenceAnchor id="fact-c461081-board-p-role" />

  **Fact:** `fact-c461081-board-p-role`

  **Value:** Proposed Board P Q1: VBEN-driven output load switch, source VBUS\_P, drain VBUS\_OUT, gate Q1\_G (replaces AO3401A C347476 in the draft spec only) · **Unit:** `NONE`

  **Conditions:** Ratings are on 1 in2 2 oz copper that the routed Board P does not have; at 5 A with 29 mOhm the loss is 0.725 W, about 40 C rise at 55 C/W and about 99 C at 137 C/W (calc). The existing 100k/150k divider gives -2.0 V asserted VGS at 5 V VBUS, inside the -1.0 to -2.5 V threshold range, so 5 V enhancement is not guaranteed. Thermal and switching behaviour unmeasured.

  **Verdict:** NEEDS BENCH · **Provenance:** PROJECT-CHOICE

  **Evidence:** [`src-c461081-primary`](#src-c461081-primary) — board\_p\_spec.py COMPONENTS Q1 row and NETS rows Q1\_G, VBUS\_P, VBUS\_OUT
</EvidenceFact>
